messages.content: អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើអ្នកជាអ្នកណា?

ខ្ញុំគឺជា AgriSystem AI (ម៉ូឌែលឈ្មោះ AGY V1.0.0) ដែលត្រូវបានបង្កើត និងអភិវឌ្ឍឡើងដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។ ខ្ញុំជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ ផ្តល់ការប្រឹក្សាអំពីដំណាំ ជំងឺដំណាំ និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាព។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើអ្នកណាបង្កើតអ្នក?
ខ្ញុំត្រូវបានបង្កើត និងអភិវឌ្ឍឡើងដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។ ម៉ូឌែលរបស់ខ្ញុំមានឈ្មោះថា AGY V1.0.0។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើនរណាជាអ្នកបង្កើត AI នេះ?
AI នេះត្រូវបានបង្កើតឡើងដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik) ជាមួយនឹងម៉ូឌែលឈ្មោះ AGY V1.0.0។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើ AI នេះបង្កើតឡើងដោយអ្នកណា?
AI នេះត្រូវបានបង្កើត និងដឹកនាំការអភិវឌ្ឍដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។ ម៉ូឌែលនេះមានឈ្មោះថា AGY V1.0.0។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើម៉ូឌែលរបស់អ្នកឈ្មោះអ្វី?
ម៉ូឌែលរបស់ខ្ញុំមានឈ្មោះថា AGY V1.0.0 បង្កើតឡើងដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើ AI នេះប្រើម៉ូឌែលអ្វី?
AI នេះដំណើរការដោយម៉ូឌែលឈ្មោះ AGY V1.0.0 ដែលត្រូវបានបង្កើតឡើងដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើប្រធានក្រុមរបស់អ្នកឈ្មោះអ្វី?
ប្រធានក្រុមដែលបានបង្កើត និងអភិវឌ្ឍខ្ញុំគឺលោក ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។ ម៉ូឌែលរបស់ខ្ញុំមានឈ្មោះថា AGY V1.0.0។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើអ្នកណាជាមេដឹកនាំគម្រោង ឬប្រធានក្រុមរបស់អ្នក?
ប្រធានក្រុម និងជាអ្នកដឹកនាំគម្រោងបង្កើតខ្ញុំគឺលោក ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។ ខ្ញុំជាម៉ូឌែល AGY V1.0.0។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
ប្រាប់ខ្ញុំអំពីខ្លួនអ្នក
ខ្ញុំគឺជា AgriSystem AI ដំណើរការដោយម៉ូឌែល AGY V1.0.0 បង្កើតឡើងដោយប្រធានក្រុម ម៉ៅ សៀវីក (Team Leader Mao Seavik)។ ខ្ញុំអាចជួយឆ្លើយសំណួរកសិកម្ម វិភាគជំងឺដំណាំ និងផ្តល់វិធីបង្ការនិងការព្យាបាលដល់កសិករ។

អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។

What are the symptoms of Rice Blast in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Blast
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: leaf has diamond shaped spots, leaves dry and die early, lesions expand quickly after rain, spots are gray in center and brown at edges
Cause: Magnaporthe infection in humid canopy.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

How do I treat Potato Early Blight in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Early Blight
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: concentric target spots on older leaves, dark lesions on stems, lower leaves yellow and drop early, plant vigor declines before maturity
Cause: Alternaria leaf blight with target spots.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

ការបង្ការ៖ - ប្រើសម្ភារៈដាំស្អាតនិងថែរក្សាអនាម័យក្នុងស្រែ។ - កាត់បន្ថយសំណើមក្នុងគម្របដំណាំដោយរកចម្ងាយដាំសមរម្យ។ - ជៀសវាងការស្រោចទឹកលើស្លឹកនៅពេលល្ងាចយប់។

What are the symptoms of Potato Bacterial Wilt in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Bacterial Wilt
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: brown ring in vascular tissue, entire plant collapses rapidly, sticky ooze from cut stem in water, sudden wilting without yellowing
Cause: Soil-borne vascular bacteria causing sudden wilt.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Tomato Late Blight in Tomato?

Crop: Tomato
Disease: Tomato Late Blight
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: brown lesions on petiole and stem, fruit shows firm brown rot, large greasy leaf lesions, white fungal growth under lesions
Cause: Rapid blight infection under wet weather.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Tomato Leaf Curl Virus in Tomato?

Crop: Tomato
Disease: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: severe stunting of plants, thickened veins and puckered leaves, upward curling of young leaves, whiteflies abundant in field

Disease: Cucumber Downy Mildew

What are the symptoms of Chili Bacterial Leaf Spot in Chili Pepper?

Crop: Chili Pepper
Disease: Chili Bacterial Leaf Spot
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: defoliation under severe attack, lesions on petiole and stem, small water soaked leaf spots, spots turn dark with yellow halo
Cause: Leaf and stem spotting bacterial infection.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Cassava Bacterial Blight in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Bacterial Blight
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: angular water soaked leaf spots, gum exudate on stem lesions, leaf wilting and dieback, tip blight after rain splash
Cause: Rain-splashed bacterial blight on leaves and stems.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Rice Sheath Blight in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Sheath Blight
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: greenish gray lesions with dark brown margins, lesions snake up the sheath to leaf blade, lodging in dense canopy, oval water soaked spots on leaf sheath, white fungal sclerotia form on lesions
Cause: Rhizoctonia solani infection in warm, humid canopy.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Bacterial Panicle Blight in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Bacterial Panicle Blight
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: discolored grains on panicle, florets turn dark brown or black, panicles remain upright due to empty grains, rotting grain husks after flowering
Cause: Burkholderia glumae bacterial panicle rot during grain filling.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Rice Nutrient Deficiency in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Nutrient Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.
Symptoms: general pale green to yellow foliage, lower leaves turn yellow and die prematurely, short panicles with light grains, stunted tillering and reduced plant height
Cause: Imbalanced nitrogen or potassium supply in flooded soil.
Treatment: - Apply corrective nutrient dose based on field observation. - Improve soil organic matter and moisture management. - Split fertilizer application to improve nutrient uptake.
Prevention: - Use balanced fertilization plan for each growth stage. - Check soil and water condition before major nutrient changes. - Avoid severe drought or waterlogging stress periods.

What are the symptoms of Rice Bakanae Disease in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Bakanae Disease
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: adventitious roots developing on lower stem nodes, pale yellow green leaves with elongated internodes, seedlings grow exceptionally tall and slender, sterile panicles or empty grains on infected tillers, whitish pink fungal coating at base of dying plants
Cause: Gibberella fujikuroi seed-borne elongation fungus.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

How do I treat Rice Leaf Scald in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Leaf Scald
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: alternating bands of dark brown and bleached light tan on leaves, blighting of upper leaf canopy after flowering, large chevron shaped zonate lesions on leaf tips, leaf tips dry out and split in wind
Cause: Microdochium oryzae causing chevron leaf tip blighting.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Narrow Brown Leaf Spot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: discoloration of leaf sheaths and glumes, premature leaf drying and canopy lodging, short narrow linear brown spots parallel to leaf veins, spots turn dark reddish brown on mature leaves
Cause: Cercospora janseana linear foliar spotting in potassium deficient soils.

Ask for missing details, mention uncertainty, and recommend a local agronomist for dangerous or severe cases. Never invent a diagnosis.
What are the symptoms of Rice Zinc Deficiency in Rice?

Crop: Rice
Disease: Rice Zinc Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.
Symptoms: brown rusty blotches appearing on middle leaves, delayed maturity by several weeks, leaf midrib chlorosis near base of young leaves, slow tillering with narrow erect dark green leaves
Cause: Zinc immobilization in continuously submerged neutral-alkaline soils.
Treatment: - Apply corrective nutrient dose based on field observation. - Improve soil organic matter and moisture management. - Split fertilizer application to improve nutrient uptake.
Prevention: - Use balanced fertilization plan for each growth stage. - Check soil and water condition before major nutrient changes. - Avoid severe drought or waterlogging stress periods.

What are the symptoms of Potato Blackleg in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Blackleg
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: black inky slimy rot at stem base, foul smelling decaying mother tuber, hollow and darkened lower stem, stunted pale yellow upright foliage
Cause: Pectobacterium infection causing vascular and tuber soft decay.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

ដំណាំ៖ ដំឡូងបារាំង

ដំណាំ៖ ដំឡូងបារាំង
ជំងឺ៖ ជំងឺរលួយស្ងួតមើមដំឡូងបារាំង
ការពិពណ៌នា៖ ជំងឺផ្សិតប៉ះពាល់ដល់សុខភាពដំណាំនិងទិន្នផល។
រោគសញ្ញា៖ ប្រហោងខាងក្នុងផ្លែមានស្រទាប់ផ្សិតពណ៌សឬផ្កាឈូកលាយខៀវ, មើមប្រែជាស្រាលស្ងួតនិងរួញរឹងដូចថ្ម, ស្នាមរលួយពណ៌ត្នោតផតជ្រួញលើស្បែកមើម
មូលហេតុ៖ មេរោគផ្សិត Fusarium ជ្រៀតចូលតាមស្នាមរបួសលើមើមពេលប្រមូលផលឬទុកដាក់។
ការព្យាបាល៖ - បាញ់ថ្នាំកម្ចាត់ផ្សិតដែលបានចុះបញ្ជីនៅដំណាក់កាលរោគសញ្ញាដំបូង។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដំណាំដែលឆ្លងខ្លាំងពីស្រែឬចម្ការ។ - បាញ់បន្ថែមតាមស្លាកថ្នាំនិងស្ថានភាពអាកាសធាតុ។
ការបង្ការ៖ - ប្រើសម្ភារៈដាំស្អាតនិងថែរក្សាអនាម័យក្នុងស្រែ។ - កាត់បន្ថយសំណើមក្នុងគម្របដំណាំដោយរកចម្ងាយដាំសមរម្យ។ - ជៀសវាងការស្រោចទឹកលើស្លឹកនៅពេលល្ងាចយប់។

What are the symptoms of Potato Wireworm Damage in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Wireworm Damage
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: dark tunnels bored through potato flesh, narrow round puncture holes bored into tubers, wilted young plants severed beneath soil line
Cause: Agriotes click beetle larvae boring into roots and tubers.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

How do I treat Potato Fusarium Dry Rot in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Fusarium Dry Rot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: sunken brown rot with concentric skin wrinkles on tubers, tuber flesh collapses into dry powdery dry rot, white yellow fungal tufts in internal tuber cavities, yellowing and wilting of lower vines
Cause: Fusarium species causing tuber dry rot during storage and postharvest.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Potato Silver Scurf in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Silver Scurf
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: dark brown smudgy lesions with indistinct margins on skin, loss of skin moisture causing tuber shrinkage in storage, silvery glistening sheen patches on washed tuber skin, slight flakiness of tuber periderm
Cause: Helminthosporium solani blemish disease on tuber periderm.

Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Potato Leak Tuber Rot in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Leak Tuber Rot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: decayed flesh turns dark brown to black when exposed to air, internal water soaked rot exuding brownish watery liquid, rotting tubers in warm moist harvest conditions, tuber skin remains intact while flesh liquefies inside
Cause: Pythium ultimum water mold infecting tubers through harvest wounds.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

How do I treat Potato White Grub Damage in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato White Grub Damage
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: deep irregular gouge holes eaten into maturing tubers, fat white c-shaped grubs discovered in soil ridge, wilting of healthy looking plants due to severed feeder roots, young potato stems clipped cleanly at soil surface
Cause: Scarabaeid beetle larvae chewing roots and gouging potato tubers.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

ការព្យាបាល៖ - តាមដានកម្រិតសត្វល្អិតនិងអនុវត្តការគ្រប់គ្រងនៅកម្រិតគោលដៅ។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដែលរងការវាយប្រហារខ្លាំងហើយកម្ទេចចោល។ - ប្រើអន្ទាក់និងថ្នាំគោលដៅនៅវគ្គដង្កូវដំបូង។

តើអ្វីជាមូលហេតុនៃជំងឺការបំផ្លាញដោយដង្កូវស៊ីឫសដំឡូងបារាំងលើដំណាំ ដំឡូងបារាំង?

ដំណាំ៖ ដំឡូងបារាំង
ជំងឺ៖ ការបំផ្លាញដោយដង្កូវស៊ីឫសដំឡូងបារាំង

មូលហេតុ៖ ដង្កូវដួងកញ្ចែស៊ីបំផ្លាញឫសនិងចោះស៊ីសាច់មើមដំឡូងបារាំង។
ការព្យាបាល៖ - តាមដានកម្រិតសត្វល្អិតនិងអនុវត្តការគ្រប់គ្រងនៅកម្រិតគោលដៅ។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដែលរងការវាយប្រហារខ្លាំងហើយកម្ទេចចោល។ - ប្រើអន្ទាក់និងថ្នាំគោលដៅនៅវគ្គដង្កូវដំបូង។

What are the symptoms of Potato Mop Top Virus in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Mop Top Virus
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: bright yellow chevron or v-shaped markings on leaves, concentric brown necrotic rings and arcs in tuber flesh, cracked and deformed harvest tubers, shortened internodes causing bunchy top foliage
Cause: Spongospora subterranea transmitted Pomovirus causing spraing in tubers.
Treatment: - Rogue infected plants early to reduce virus source. - Control insect vectors with integrated pest management. - Replant with clean seedlings only after vector pressure drops.
Prevention: - Use resistant varieties when available. - Start with virus-free seedling material. - Control vector host weeds around field boundaries.

តើជំងឺមេរោគម៉ប់ថបដំឡូងបារាំងលើដំណាំ ដំឡូងបារាំង មានរោគសញ្ញាអ្វីខ្លះ?

ដំណាំ៖ ដំឡូងបារាំង
ជំងឺ៖ មេរោគម៉ប់ថបដំឡូងបារាំង
ការពិពណ៌នា៖ ជំងឺវីរុសភាគច្រើនឆ្លងតាមសត្វល្អិតជាអ្នកផ្ទុករោគ។
រោគសញ្ញា៖ ថ្នាំងដើមខ្លីធ្វើឱ្យស្លឹកកំពូលកញ្ចុំញឹក, មើមប្រេះស្រាំនិងខូចទ្រង់ទ្រាយពេលប្រមូលផល, រង្វង់និងធ្នូស្នាមងាប់ពណ៌ត្នោតក្នុងសាច់មើម, ស្នាមឆ្នូតពណ៌លឿងភ្លឺរាងអក្សរវីលើស្លឹក
មូលហេតុ៖ មេរោគវីរុស Pomovirus ចម្លងដោយផ្សិត Spongospora subterranea បង្កស្នាមឆ្នូតក្នុងសាច់មើម។
ការព្យាបាល៖ - ដកដើមដែលឆ្លងចេញឱ្យបានឆាប់ដើម្បីកាត់បន្ថយប្រភពរោគ។ - គ្រប់គ្រងសត្វល្អិតផ្ទុករោគតាមវិធានការការពារចម្រុះ។ - ដាំឡើងវិញដោយប្រើពូជស្អាតបន្ទាប់ពីសម្ពាធសត្វល្អិតថយចុះ។
ការបង្ការ៖ - ប្រើពូជធន់ជំងឺប្រសិនបើមាន។ - ចាប់ផ្តើមពីសំណាបឬវត្ថុដាំដែលគ្មានវីរុស។ - គ្រប់គ្រងស្មៅជាអ្នកផ្ទុកសត្វល្អិតជុំវិញស្រែ។

messages.content: អ្នកគឺជា AgriSystem ដែលជាជំនួយការកសិកម្មឆ្លាតវៃ និងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់។ សូមផ្តល់ដំបូន្មានជាក់ស្តែង និងច្បាស់លាស់អំពីជំងឺដំណាំ សត្វល្អិត ដី ការស្រោចស្រព និងការព្យាបាលប្រកបដោយសុវត្ថិភាពជាភាសាខ្មែរ។ ប្រសិនបើព័ត៌មានមិនគ្រប់គ្រាន់ សូមបញ្ជាក់ និងណែនាំឱ្យពិគ្រោះអ្នកជំនាញកសិកម្មក្នុងតំបន់។
តើខ្ញុំគួរព្យាបាលជំងឺមេរោគម៉ប់ថបដំឡូងបារាំងលើដំណាំ ដំឡូងបារាំង ដូចម្តេច?

ដំណាំ៖ ដំឡូងបារាំង
ជំងឺ៖ មេរោគម៉ប់ថបដំឡូងបារាំង
ការពិពណ៌នា៖ ជំងឺវីរុសភាគច្រើនឆ្លងតាមសត្វល្អិតជាអ្នកផ្ទុករោគ។
រោគសញ្ញា៖ ថ្នាំងដើមខ្លីធ្វើឱ្យស្លឹកកំពូលកញ្ចុំញឹក, មើមប្រេះស្រាំនិងខូចទ្រង់ទ្រាយពេលប្រមូលផល, រង្វង់និងធ្នូស្នាមងាប់ពណ៌ត្នោតក្នុងសាច់មើម, ស្នាមឆ្នូតពណ៌លឿងភ្លឺរាងអក្សរវីលើស្លឹក
មូលហេតុ៖ មេរោគវីរុស Pomovirus ចម្លងដោយផ្សិត Spongospora subterranea បង្កស្នាមឆ្នូតក្នុងសាច់មើម។
ការព្យាបាល៖ - ដកដើមដែលឆ្លងចេញឱ្យបានឆាប់ដើម្បីកាត់បន្ថយប្រភពរោគ។ - គ្រប់គ្រងសត្វល្អិតផ្ទុករោគតាមវិធានការការពារចម្រុះ។ - ដាំឡើងវិញដោយប្រើពូជស្អាតបន្ទាប់ពីសម្ពាធសត្វល្អិតថយចុះ។
ការបង្ការ៖ - ប្រើពូជធន់ជំងឺប្រសិនបើមាន។ - ចាប់ផ្តើមពីសំណាបឬវត្ថុដាំដែលគ្មានវីរុស។ - គ្រប់គ្រងស្មៅជាអ្នកផ្ទុកសត្វល្អិតជុំវិញស្រែ។

What are the symptoms of Potato Potassium Deficiency in Potato?

Crop: Potato
Disease: Potato Potassium Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.
Symptoms: leaves become dull dark green with necrotic edges, marginal leaf scorch and bronze curling on older leaves, premature vine death and small tubers, uniform chlorosis of lower foliage progressing upward
Cause: Potassium deficiency causing foliar marginal scorch and small tubers.
Treatment: - Apply corrective nutrient dose based on field observation. - Improve soil organic matter and moisture management. - Split fertilizer application to improve nutrient uptake.
Prevention: - Use balanced fertilization plan for each growth stage. - Check soil and water condition before major nutrient changes. - Avoid severe drought or waterlogging stress periods.

How can I prevent Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot in Tomato?

Crop: Tomato
Disease: Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: foliage loss exposes fruits to sunscald, numerous small circular spots with gray center and dark border, severe lower leaf yellowing and shedding, tiny black specks inside leaf spots
Cause: Septoria lycopersici causing dense lower foliage spotting.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Tomato Spider Mite Damage in Tomato?

Disease: Tomato Spider Mite Damage
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: bronzed or bleached dried leaves, delicate silken webbing on shoot tips and under leaves, fine yellow stippling and speckled foliage, tiny red mites crawling on leaf underside

Disease: Tomato Gray Mold Blight
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: fuzzy grayish brown mold on flowers and fruit stems, pale water-soaked spots on green fruit (ghost spots), soft rot of flowers causing heavy flower drop

How do I treat Tomato Bacterial Canker in Tomato?

Crop: Tomato
Disease: Tomato Bacterial Canker
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: brown necrotic streaks and open cankers on stems, marginal leaf scorch with white yellow halo, small white blister spots with dark centers on fruit, yellowish pith breakdown inside split stem
Cause: Clavibacter michiganensis systemic bacterial vascular infection.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.

ដំណាំ៖ ប៉េងប៉ោះ
ជំងឺ៖ ជំងឺដំបៅបាក់តេរីដើមនិងផ្លែប៉េងប៉ោះ

Crop: Tomato
Disease: Tomato Fusarium Crown Rot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: chocolate brown vascular discoloration limited to lower stem, dark brown rot on taproot and main root crown, gradual wilting and collapse of mature fruiting vines, yellowing of lower leaves progressing slowly upward
Cause: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. radicis-lycopersici root collar decay.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

Disease: Tomato Tobacco Mosaic Virus
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: blistered dark green and light green mosaic on leaves, fern leaf symptom with extremely narrow distorted leaflets, internal brown browning of fruit wall, uneven ripening with mottled yellow green patches on fruit
Cause: Tobamovirus mechanically transmitted through contact and tools.

What are the symptoms of Cucumber Bacterial Wilt in Cucumber?

Crop: Cucumber
Disease: Cucumber Bacterial Wilt
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: cucumber beetles feeding on foliage in field, dull dark green color of wilted foliage without initial yellowing, individual leaves wilt during hot day, recover at night, then wilt permanently, viscous white bacterial strands stringing when cut stem ends are pulled apart
Cause: Erwinia tracheiphila vascular bacterium transmitted by cucumber beetles.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Cucumber Belly Rot in Cucumber?

Crop: Cucumber
Disease: Cucumber Belly Rot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: brown webbing and fungal threads clinging to rotted fruit rind, crusty brown rot on fruit side resting on wet ground, decayed fruit becomes soft, watery and unmarketable, water-soaked yellow brown sunken lesions on underside of fruit touching soil
Cause: Rhizoctonia solani soil-contact fruit decay in wet beds.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

Disease: Cucumber Magnesium Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.

Cause: Magnesium deficiency in sandy leached soils under heavy fruit load.

What are the symptoms of Chili Phytophthora Blight in Chili Pepper?

Crop: Chili Pepper
Disease: Chili Phytophthora Blight
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: constriction and girdling of lower stem near soil, dark brown to black water soaked lesions at stem base, rapid wilting of entire green plant without leaf yellowing, white mold growth on dark fruit lesions after rain
Cause: Phytophthora capsici crown and fruit rot under saturated soil.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Chili Powdery Mildew in Chili Pepper?

Crop: Chili Pepper
Disease: Chili Powdery Mildew
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: bare branches with few exposed sunburnt fruits, bright yellow chlorotic patches on upper leaf surface, severe upward curling and premature leaf shedding, white powdery fungal coating on leaf underside
Cause: Leveillula taurica endophytic powdery mildew on solanaceous crops.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Chili Broad Mite Infestation in Chili Pepper?

Crop: Chili Pepper
Disease: Chili Broad Mite Infestation
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: brittle and leathery leaf texture with glossy sheen, bronzed and distorted growing tips, cracked and corky fruit skin, downward curling and cupping of young leaves
Cause: Polyphagotarsonemus latus feeding on chili growing tips and flower buds.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

Disease: Chili Bacterial Wilt
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.

Disease: Chili Cercospora Leaf Spot

How do I treat Banana Crown Rot in Banana?

Crop: Banana
Disease: Banana Crown Rot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: blackening and rotting of fruit crown tissues, fruit fingers separating and dropping from crown, white or gray fungal mold on severed hand cushions
Cause: Colletotrichum and Fusarium complex decaying cushion tissue.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Banana Corm Borer Weevil in Banana?

Crop: Banana
Disease: Banana Corm Borer Weevil
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: jelly-like sap exudation from base of plant, larval tunnels riddling root corm and bulb, plants easily pushed over by hand, yellowing and dying of outer leaf canopy
Cause: Cosmopolites sordidus larvae tunneling in underground corm.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

រោគសញ្ញា៖ ការបញ្ចេញទឹកដមស្អិតមានស្រទាប់ផ្សិតខ្មៅស្រោប, ភ្នាក់ងារចម្លងរោគបង្កឱ្យចេញរោគសញ្ញាកំពូលកញ្ចុំចេក, ហ្វូងអាហ្វីតពណ៌ត្នោតចាស់នៅគល់និងបំពង់កដើមចេក, អាហ្វីតពួនក្រោមស្រទបស្លឹកនិងក្រោមស្រទាប់ត្រយ៉ូង
មូលហេតុ៖ សត្វចៃចេកផ្តុំគ្នានៅគល់ធាងនិងបណ្តូលចេកជាភ្នាក់ងារចម្លងមេរោគក្រិនចេក។
ការព្យាបាល៖ - តាមដានកម្រិតសត្វល្អិតនិងអនុវត្តការគ្រប់គ្រងនៅកម្រិតគោលដៅ។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដែលរងការវាយប្រហារខ្លាំងហើយកម្ទេចចោល។ - ប្រើអន្ទាក់និងថ្នាំគោលដៅនៅវគ្គដង្កូវដំបូង។
ការបង្ការ៖ - ថែរក្សាអនាម័យស្រែនិងកាត់បន្ថយរុក្ខជាតិជាម្ចាស់ផ្ទុកសត្វល្អិត។ - អភិរក្សសត្វជួយស៊ីសត្វល្អិតនិងជៀសវាងថ្នាំទូលំទូលាយលើសកម្រិត។ - ត្រួតពិនិត្យដំណាំជាប្រចាំនិងដោះស្រាយឱ្យបានឆាប់។

What are the symptoms of Banana Potassium Deficiency in Banana?

Crop: Banana
Disease: Banana Potassium Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.
Symptoms: premature drying and folding of older leaf canopy, rapid yellowing and orange necrosis of leaf margins curling inward, slender weak pseudostems that buckle under bunch weight, small poorly filled banana fingers with brittle skin

What are the symptoms of Corn Gray Leaf Spot in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Gray Leaf Spot
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: blighted and prematurely dried lower leaves, lesions turn grayish brown under high humidity, rectangular narrow tan lesions delimited by leaf veins, severe leaf loss during grain filling stage
Cause: Cercospora zeae-maydis causing rectangular interveinal blights.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

ដំណាំ៖ ពោត
ជំងឺ៖ ជំងឺអុចប្រផេះស្លឹកពោត

ការព្យាបាល៖ - បាញ់ថ្នាំកម្ចាត់ផ្សិតដែលបានចុះបញ្ជីនៅដំណាក់កាលរោគសញ្ញាដំបូង។ - ដកចេញផ្នែកដំណាំដែលឆ្លងខ្លាំងពីស្រែឬចម្ការ។ - បាញ់បន្ថែមតាមស្លាកថ្នាំនិងស្ថានភាពអាកាសធាតុ។
ការបង្ការ៖ - ប្រើសម្ភារៈដាំស្អាតនិងថែរក្សាអនាម័យក្នុងស្រែ។ - កាត់បន្ថយសំណើមក្នុងគម្របដំណាំដោយរកចម្ងាយដាំសមរម្យ។ - ជៀសវាងការស្រោចទឹកលើស្លឹកនៅពេលល្ងាចយប់។

What are the symptoms of Corn Smut in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Smut
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: distorted and malformed corn ears, galls rupture revealing powdery black spore masses, large swollen spongy galls on ears tassels or stalk, stunted plants with abnormal tassel growth
Cause: Ustilago maydis gall formation on ears, tassels, and stalks.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Corn Downy Mildew in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Downy Mildew
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: chlorotic yellow white striping from leaf base to tip, crazy top symptom with leafy tassel proliferation, downy white fungal growth on leaf underside in morning, stunted plants with barren ears or poor seed set
Cause: Peronosclerospora species causing systemic chlorotic striping.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

Symptoms: chlorotic yellow white striping from leaf base to tip, crazy top symptom with leafy tassel proliferation, downy white fungal growth on leaf underside in morning, stunted plants with barren ears or poor seed set
Cause: Peronosclerospora species causing systemic chlorotic striping.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

Disease: Corn Rootworm Damage
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.

ជំងឺ៖ ការខូចខាតឫសដោយដង្កូវឫសពោត
ការពិពណ៌នា៖ ការខូចខាតដោយសត្វល្អិតប៉ះពាល់ដល់កំណើននិងទិន្នផល។

What are the symptoms of Corn Bacterial Stalk Rot in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Bacterial Stalk Rot
Description: Bacterial infection causing rapid leaf or vascular damage.
Symptoms: dark water soaked soft rot on middle stalk internodes, foul fermenting odor emitted from decaying stalk, slime and bacterial decay in inner nodal tissue, stalk collapses and twists at rot point while top leaves remain green
Cause: Dickeya zeae / Pectobacterium soft rotting bacterium under flooded warm conditions.
Treatment: - Remove severely infected plants or leaves quickly. - Apply registered bactericide where allowed. - Disinfect tools and avoid handling wet plants.
Prevention: - Use clean seed or planting material from trusted sources. - Avoid splash spread from uncontrolled irrigation. - Rotate crops and destroy infected residues after harvest.

What are the symptoms of Corn Anthracnose Leaf Blight in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Anthracnose Leaf Blight
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: black rotted pith inside lower stalk causing late lodging, oval to spindle shaped tan leaf spots with dark reddish borders, shiny black streaks and spots on outer stalk surface, top dieback symptom with upper leaves dying prematurely
Cause: Colletotrichum graminicola causing leaf blight and stalk rot.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Corn Aphid Infestation in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Aphid Infestation
Description: Pest or insect damage reducing plant vigor and yield.
Symptoms: black sooty mold covering ear husks and leaves, dense clusters of bluish green aphids inside whorl and on tassels, interfered pollination resulting in incomplete ear kernel fill, tassels and silks coated in sticky glistening honeydew
Cause: Rhopalosiphum maidis corn leaf aphids infesting whorl and tassels.
Treatment: - Monitor pest level and apply selective control at threshold. - Remove heavily infested plant parts and destroy them. - Use traps and targeted treatment for early larval stages.
Prevention: - Maintain field hygiene and reduce alternate pest hosts. - Encourage natural enemies and avoid unnecessary broad sprays. - Inspect crop regularly and act early before severe spread.

What are the symptoms of Corn Head Smut in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Head Smut
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: absence of normal ear development with floral teardrop galls, entire ear or tassel converted into mass of powdery black spores, tassel proliferation into leafy vegetative structures, vascular fiber remnants left standing in ruptured spore mass
Cause: Sphacelotheca reiliana systemic floral smut fungus.
Treatment: - Apply a registered fungicide at early symptom stage. - Remove heavily infected plant parts from the field. - Repeat application based on product label and weather risk.
Prevention: - Use clean planting material and maintain field sanitation. - Reduce canopy humidity by proper spacing and airflow. - Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from late overhead irrigation.

What are the symptoms of Corn Zinc Deficiency in Corn?

Crop: Corn
Disease: Corn Zinc Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.
Symptoms: broad white or yellow bands on either side of leaf midrib, lower leaves dry up and turn brown early, severely stunted plants with shortened internodes, v-shaped yellowing starting from leaf tip along midrib
Cause: Zinc deficiency in high pH or high phosphorus soils.
Treatment: - Apply corrective nutrient dose based on field observation. - Improve soil organic matter and moisture management. - Split fertilizer application to improve nutrient uptake.
Prevention: - Use balanced fertilization plan for each growth stage. - Check soil and water condition before major nutrient changes. - Avoid severe drought or waterlogging stress periods.

What are the symptoms of Cassava Brown Streak Disease in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Brown Streak Disease
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: brown necrotic streaks on green stem bark, feathery yellow chlorosis along secondary leaf veins, radial constriction and dark brown corky dry rot in root flesh, unusable woody root tubers at harvest
Cause: Ipomovirus causing feathery chlorosis and tuberous root necrosis.
Treatment: - Rogue infected plants early to reduce virus source. - Control insect vectors with integrated pest management. - Replant with clean seedlings only after vector pressure drops.
Prevention: - Use resistant varieties when available. - Start with virus-free seedling material. - Control vector host weeds around field boundaries.

What are the symptoms of Cassava Anthracnose Disease in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Anthracnose Disease
Description: Fungal disease affecting crop health and yield.
Symptoms: cankers and lesions on green stems and petiole axils, deep cracks and gum exudation on mature stems, tip dieback and wilting of young shoot branches, weak brittle stems easily snapping in wind

What are the symptoms of Cassava Nutrient Deficiency in Cassava?

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Nutrient Deficiency
Description: Nutrition-related stress causing abnormal growth symptoms.
Symptoms: interveinal yellowing with prominent green veins, purplish red tint on older leaf margins, stunted umbrella-like canopy
Cause: Magnesium and potassium depletion in sandy acidic soils.
Treatment: - Apply corrective nutrient dose based on field observation. - Improve soil organic matter and moisture management. - Split fertilizer application to improve nutrient uptake.
Prevention: - Use balanced fertilization plan for each growth stage. - Check soil and water condition before major nutrient changes. - Avoid severe drought or waterlogging stress periods.

Crop: Cassava
Disease: Cassava Witches Broom Disease
Description: Viral disease often spread by insect vectors.
Symptoms: excessive proliferation of short thin branches at shoot apex, reduced root tuber size and high fiber content, severe stunting of plant with bushy broom-like canopy, tiny narrow yellowed leaves on apical clusters
Cause: Phytoplasma systemic infection causing proliferation of shoots.
Treatment: - Rogue infected plants early to reduce virus source. - Control insect vectors with integrated pest management. - Replant with clean seedlings only after vector pressure drops.
Prevention: - Use resistant varieties when available. - Start with virus-free seedling material. - Control vector host weeds around field boundaries.
